description: We currently have an exciting opening within our Client Experience and Product Development team for a Client Experience and Product Analyst. The Client Experience function at Mediolanum plays a key role in understanding how clients experience our products and then translating this into meaningful business insights, reporting and action. Working across multiple business areas, the role of a Client Experience Analyst combines commercial thinking, technical expertise and stakeholder engagement to support client outcomes, product development and strategic decision making. The successful candidate will work across the full product lifecycle, from initial concepts and product development through to ongoing monitoring, client outcome assessment and management reporting. You will gain exposure to Product, Investments, Finance, Operations, Risk and IT, while building strong relationships across the business and contributing to projects that have a direct impact on clients and business performance. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to accelerate their career through broad exposure to senior stakeholders, cross-functional projects and high-profile reporting. The role offers the chance to own key management information, develop innovative analytical solutions, influence business decisions and help shape the future use of data, automation and AI within the organisation. Duties and responsibilities will include, but not limited to the following: Improve the client experience by understanding client needs, behaviours and pain points, and translating these into practical improvements, insights, tools and solutions. Develop client, product and commercial insights, turning complex data into clear narratives, meaningful KPIs and actionable recommendations that support decision-making. Design, build and maintain dashboards, analytical tools and reporting solutions, combining business knowledge with technical expertise to deliver scalable and accessible solutions. Develop expertise in client performance, client reporting and outcome metrics, supporting business, product, governance and regulatory requirements. Own key management and client reporting, including reports presented to internal committees and information provided as part of Board reporting, ensuring outputs are accurate, clear and appropriate for the audience. Support activities across the product lifecycle, from product development through to ongoing product management, using data and analysis to support product and client outcomes. Work with IT and data owners to support data quality, validation, governance and automation, including transitioning manual processes towards more robust and scalable solutions. Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Product, Investments, Finance, Operations, IT and Risk, working collaboratively across the business to support shared objectives and deliver effective outcomes. Take ownership of projects and analytical workstreams from problem definition and requirements gathering through to delivery and implementation, independently managing priorities, milestones and timelines. Maintain a strong understanding of financial markets, investment products and emerging technologies, proactively identifying opportunities to use data, automation and AI to improve client outcomes and business processes. Skills and Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, together with a commercial mindset and the ability to turn complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations. Demonstrable technical capability across databases, SQL, Python or other relevant programming languages, and data visualisation tools. Strong stakeholder and project management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and communicate confidently with senior stakeholders. The ability to work autonomously and proactively, take ownership of work and independently manage multiple priorities through to completion. Excellent attention to detail, with a strong focus on data accuracy and the quality of analysis and reporting. Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly to different audiences. Qualifications and Experience: A relevant third-level qualification in finance, economics, computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline. A postgraduate or relevant professional qualification would be an advantage. A demonstrable interest in financial markets, investment products and client outcomes, with a focus on delivering high-quality products and experiences for clients. A strong combination of commercial, analytical and technical capability, with the ability to understand business problems and translate them into practical data-led solutions. Experience with modern data and cloud technologies. Experience with Snowflake would be a distinct advantage. An understanding of AI technologies and their practical application to analytics, automation and business processes. Experience with AI tools, APIs or endpoints, or AI-assisted development would be an advantage.
title: Client Experience and Product Analyst

description: Job Description Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! Digital Marketing Manager at Conrad Dubai – Join our award-winning team and lead innovative digital strategies that elevate our luxury brand, strengthen online engagement, and drive direct bookings. Through compelling content, performance marketing, and seamless digital experiences, you’ll help guests discover Conrad Dubai and inspire memorable stays from the very first click – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. Responsibilities Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day as a Digital Marketing Manager at Conrad Dubai: Develop Digital Marketing Strategies: Create and execute strategies aligned with the hotel’s commercial objectives, brand positioning, and revenue targets. Manage Paid Advertising: Plan and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and other platforms to drive awareness, engagement, bookings, and revenue. Promote Hotel Experiences: Develop seasonal and always-on campaigns for Rooms, Restaurants, Brunches, Pool Experiences, Spa, Wellness, Events, E-Gift Cards, and E-Shop. Optimise Campaign Performance: Manage audience targeting, remarketing, A/B testing, budgets, and conversion optimisation to maximise ROI and advertising effectiveness. Manage OTA Platforms: Collaborate with Revenue Management and Commercial teams to optimise hotel listings, content accuracy, promotional offers, visibility, and bookings across third-party platforms. Drive Spa and Wellness Revenue: Manage spa digital campaigns and online booking platforms to increase awareness, appointments, conversions, and repeat visits. Optimise F&B Reservations: Oversee SevenRooms digital performance, enhancing reservation journeys and campaigns for restaurants, brunches, and pool experiences. Generate Event Leads: Develop and optimise digital campaigns for MICE, corporate events, weddings, social celebrations, and group bookings, tracking enquiries through to confirmed business. Maintain Website Excellence: Ensure hotel websites and approved digital platforms feature accurate information, compelling visuals, current offers, and seamless booking journeys. Enhance WhatsApp Marketing: Drive campaign performance, improve enquiry handling, and track conversations, bookings, conversions, and attributed revenue. Manage CRM and Email Marketing: Deliver targeted email campaigns, newsletters, and guest re-engagement initiatives to encourage repeat bookings and cross-selling while maintaining database accuracy and consent compliance. Coordinate Social Media Content: Partner with Marketing and creative teams to align paid campaigns, organic content, photography, and promotional assets with luxury brand standards. Strengthen Online Reputation: Monitor digital listings, search visibility, and guest feedback trends to maintain accurate information and a consistent luxury brand presence. Analyse Digital Performance: Use Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and advertising dashboards to track conversions, revenue attribution, ROAS, ROI, CPA, and CPL. Deliver Performance Reports: Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports with actionable insights, budget updates, campaign results, and recommendations. Collaborate Across Departments: Work closely with Marketing, Commercial, Revenue Management, Sales, F&B, Spa, and Operations teams to align campaigns with business priorities. Ensure Brand and Data Compliance: Maintain Hilton brand standards and ensure digital campaigns, guest databases, and communications meet corporate policies and applicable privacy requirements. Drive Digital Innovation: Identify emerging technologies, hospitality trends, competitor activity, and new opportunities to enhance digital engagement and commercial performance. Champion Exceptional Guest Experiences: Ensure every digital touchpoint reflects Conrad Dubai’s luxury positioning through thoughtful communication, attention to detail, and seamless guest journeys. Qualifications What It Takes to Make the Stay At Hilton, our core values are the driving force behind our success and shape the qualities we look for in every team member. As part of the award-winning Conrad Dubai team , you’ll bring these values to life through thoughtful service, attention to detail, and memorable experiences that define luxury hospitality. A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact. About Us Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel. Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical. Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work. About The Team How We’ll Help You Thrive Benefits At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*: Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

description: Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Business Analyst with 4+ years of experience in the IT industry to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams. The candidate will be responsible for understanding business requirements, analyzing processes, translating requirements into functional and technical specifications, and working closely with development and QA teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira, requirement gathering, user stories, functional specifications, process mapping, and stakeholder management , along with a good understanding of programming languages, databases, APIs, web technologies, and software development life cycles . Key Responsibilities 1. Business & Requirement Analysis Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders. Conduct requirement-gathering sessions, workshops, interviews, and discussions with business users. Understand business processes, identify gaps, and recommend technology-driven solutions. Translate business requirements into clear and actionable functional requirements . Identify dependencies, assumptions, constraints, risks, and potential impacts of proposed solutions. Analyze existing systems and processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, clear, and testable. 2. Agile & Scrum Responsibilities Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Developers, QA Engineers, Architects, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment. Participate in Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives . Create and maintain product backlog items, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Break down complex business requirements into smaller, manageable user stories. Support the Product Owner in prioritizing and maintaining the product backlog. Clarify requirements and resolve functional queries raised by development and QA teams during sprints. Ensure stories meet the Definition of Ready and Definition of Done where applicable. Participate in release planning and support successful delivery of sprint/release objectives. 3. Jira & Requirement Management Create, manage, and track Epics, User Stories, Tasks, Bugs, and Sub-tasks in Jira . Maintain Jira backlog and ensure requirements are properly linked and traceable. Monitor story status, dependencies, blockers, and delivery progress. Work with technical teams to ensure Jira tickets contain sufficient functional and acceptance criteria. Maintain requirement traceability from business requirements through development and testing. Generate and review Jira reports and dashboards to track project progress. 4. User Stories & Functional Documentation Prepare detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), User Stories, Use Cases, Process Flow Diagrams, and Acceptance Criteria . Write user stories using the appropriate Agile format. Define positive, negative, and edge-case scenarios for requirements. Develop functional specifications for new features and enhancements. Maintain documentation throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure requirements remain aligned with business objectives and agreed scope. 5. Technical Understanding The candidate should have a good working knowledge of software development concepts and technologies, including: Understanding of SDLC and STLC . Basic to intermediate knowledge of programming languages such as: Java Python JavaScript / TypeScript C# / .NET SQL Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. Good understanding of REST APIs, SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS , and API integrations. Understanding of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript , and web/application architecture. Working knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or SQL Server. Ability to write and understand basic SQL queries for data validation and analysis. Understanding of frontend, backend, database, and API layers. Familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage. Basic understanding of microservices, application integrations, authentication, and system interfaces is preferred. Ability to understand technical discussions and communicate effectively with development teams. 6. Data Analysis & Validation Analyze business and system data to identify trends, issues, and opportunities. Validate data and business rules using SQL and other analytical tools. Work with technical teams to investigate data discrepancies. Define data requirements, validation rules, and business logic. Support data mapping and integration requirements where applicable. 7. Testing & Quality Assurance Collaborate with QA teams to ensure requirements are testable. Review test scenarios and test cases against business requirements. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) . Coordinate with business users during UAT and help resolve functional issues. Validate developed functionality against acceptance criteria. Assist in defect triaging, prioritization, and resolution. Perform functional validation where required. 8. Stakeholder Management Act as a key communication bridge between business and technical teams. Communicate complex technical concepts in a simple and understandable manner to business stakeholders. Conduct product demonstrations and requirement walkthroughs. Manage stakeholder expectations regarding requirements, scope, dependencies, and timelines. Resolve requirement conflicts and obtain necessary approvals. Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 9. Process Improvement Analyze existing business workflows and identify inefficiencies. Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities. Prepare As-Is and To-Be process flows . Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce manual processes, and enhance customer experience. Participate in digital transformation and system modernization initiatives. 10. Project & Release Support Work with Project Managers/Product Owners to support project planning and delivery. Track requirement-related risks, issues, and dependencies. Support impact analysis for change requests. Evaluate changes and enhancements based on business value and technical feasibility. Assist with release planning, production readiness, and post-release validation. Support production teams in understanding functional requirements and resolving business-related issues.
title: Business Analyst
